title: 911 calls from the facility intercepted
place_text: Baker Victory Services, Western New York

tellings.quote: like get out, call 911 from the school facility, but the lines were surveiled.

plain: Jordan Jose, a man who says a secret UFO programme took him as a child, says that between about 2008 and 2010 he tried to escape and call 911 from Baker Victory Services, a facility in Western New York that he describes as a school. He says "the lines were surveiled", so his calls were intercepted. He tells Michels this as something he lived through. If true, the people holding him were watching the facility's phone lines.
